# 🥛 MME Extensions v1.7.1

Bug? In MCM > MME Extensions > Troubleshooting, turn on master papyrus toggle, reproduce your bug, than  Create Bug Report  button. Send to ChatGPT or post here.

## 🌟 Major Features

- **Mimics & Dungeon Worms:** Treasure chests can trigger encounters that drain your milk. The milkier you are, the higher the odds. Lucky you! ...Right? Mimics require an FNIS-compatible animation loader such as Pandora or Nemesis.
- **Breast-Covering Animations:** Milk Maids cup their breasts when more than half full. Can't let them leak! Requires Open Animation Replacer (OAR).
- **Breastfeeding Seduction:** Milk Maids can offer thirsty patrons a drink. Who's up for a sip?
  - Use **Thirsty Patrons** in Magelight UI to find a random nearby patron.
  - Use **Hey There** to make an offer to a specific target.
  - A full Milk Maid may make an offer on her own.
- **Breastfeeding Shout:** Drink any milk to learn the shout and use it to start a group breastfeeding scene. Fuz Roh AHHH!

## 🔧 Minor Features

- **Movement Sounds:** More breast slap sounds to choose from in the MCM.
- **Corrupted Armor:** Treasure chests can corrupt equipped chest armor with tentacles or Dwemer attachments.
- **Korean Translation:** Added Korean language support.

## ✨ Improvements

- **Skyrim.Net Narration:** Clearer instructions help NPCs stay in character.
- **FOMOD & MCM:** Clarified wording and reorganized menus.
- **Dwemer Armor Checks:** The blacksmith checks armor sooner and offers upgrades more reliably.
- **Language Packs:** Polished existing translations.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Milk Maid Lore Book:** Skyrim.Net injects it only once per dialogue.
- **NPC Context:** Fixed overlapping Skyrim.Net context updates.
- **Skyrim.Net Config & Narration:** Fixed settings mismatches and narration triggers.
- **MilkQuest & SexLab:** Fixed a MilkQuest warning and errors caused by missing SexLab voices.
